title: Black September Infinity Malibu Ultraverse 1995 Marvel Merge Wraparound Cover
condition_description: Edge and corner wear, light scuffing on the black cover, small chips at the spine edge. See photos.
description:
Black September #Infinity (1995), Malibu Comics / Ultraverse - the Black September event that relaunched the Ultraverse. Wraparound back art (DeVictoria, Danko & Mann, Wyman, Butler, Conroy & Gecko, Reed, Welch, Florimonte & Petrecca). $1.50 cover price.

Condition: edge and corner wear, light scuffing on the black cover and small chips at the spine edge (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
